item.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
item.description: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

item.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
